title: Ngumoha turns Anfield tie as Liverpool come back from two down
summary: Liverpool beat Villarreal 4-3 to make it three wins from three in the league phase after trailing 2-0 inside half an hour, with Georges Mikautadze and Sergi Cardona punishing slack defending. Alexis Mac Allister scored either side of a Ronald Araújo header, 18-year-old Rio Ngumoha set up both first-half goals, and Florian Wirtz added a fourth before Tani Oluwaseyi's late reply.
